AC1.evidence: selector.py:278-287 — `if has_pos and not has_neg` → computes val_corr → `if val_corr < -min_abs_corr: continue`. Test `test_val_sign_disagrees_negative_blacklists` confirms.

AC2.description: Feature with consistent positive train signs and matching positive val sign is kept
AC2.evidence: When val_corr > 0, `val_corr < -min_abs_corr` is False → falls through to `stable_features.add(col)`. Test `test_val_sign_matches_positive_kept` confirms.

AC3.description: Feature with tiny |val_rho| < min_abs_corr is kept
AC3.evidence: `val_corr < -min_abs_corr` won't fire when |val_corr| < min_abs_corr. Test `test_val_sign_tiny_corr_kept` confirms with shuffled labels.

AC4.evidence: Entire val check gated on `val_df is not None` (line 277). Test `test_val_df_none_matches_previous_behavior` confirms mixed train signs still blacklisted.

AC5.description: val_df without label_close_288 column skips val check (no crash)
AC5.evidence: `label_col in val_df.columns` guard at line 277. Also `col in val_df.columns` for extra robustness. Test `test_val_df_missing_label_col_skips_check` confirms.

AC6.evidence: Byte-for-byte identical signature verified: `_check_spearman_sign_consistency(df, feature_cols, n_folds, min_folds, val_df=None, min_abs_corr=None) -> set[str]`.

AC7.evidence: 74 passed (69 existing + 5 new) in 8.38s with PYTEST_LOW_MEMORY=1.

code_placement_checks.guards_correct: val_df is not None AND label_col in val_df.columns AND col in val_df.columns
code_placement_checks.threshold_logic_correct: |val_rho| >= min_abs_corr required to override train sign
code_placement_checks.sign_comparison_correct: val_corr < -min_abs_corr for train-pos/val-neg; val_corr > min_abs_corr for train-neg/val-pos
